nom: COSRX 5 PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Vital Hydrating Hydrogel Mask with Collagen & Adenosine

avis.titre: See instant results in your skin
avis.texte: The best mask I have ever used Works best overnight which is a bit inconvenient and uncomfortable but in the morning there is visual improvement to lines and skin texture I love this product!
Works perfectly with the toner and serum and left my skin feeling supple and rejuvenated. A perfect self-care activity.

I thought this mask would be difficult to put on because it has a slit on one side, but I was pleasantly surprised that it was actually pretty easy. It was super hydrating, didn't have a smell and I also like that it changes in transparency to let you know it's ready to be taken off. Overall, I really liked this mask and would recommend it!
This is true hydration. My skin feels and looks soft, smooth and healthy after one use.

So this is my first time using a mask overnight and at first I was worried about what I would wake up to, but this was actually super comfortable. Cooling, hydrating and not sticky. There was not a dry or itchy patch in sight when I took it off in the morning. There was also none of that serum dripping into the corners of my eyes and burning business. My skin looked visibly brighter and plumper. Like I'm out here feeling like the definition of Sunny QQ. I would 100 percent recommend this to others and will be buying it for my Sunday self care refresh evening routine.
You can see hydration on my face! My skin glowing after overnight mask. . I only noticed that hyaluronic acid is not very good for skin if you use retinol and it might feel sensitive.
This is a terrific mask. I was left with hydrated and glowy skin. My face felt plump and looked refreshed. I would recommend.

What a great spa quality treatment for your face. Love the idea that it has to sit on your skin longer than the generic 15 or 20 min masks (not that they are bad), but this mask is truly restores your look. It does slide down thanks to gravity so try to stay put, maybe use it while watching tv or reading a book. I would best recommend it after a hot dry summer day, a cold windy winter night or after a long flight.

I absolutely love this new face mask. The look of it is very seamless compared to other face masks I've used. I love the hydrating feel on my skin after I use it in particular. The only downside is that you need to leave the mask on for at least 2 hours. It's definitely a mask to save when you're having a self-love Friday night!

These have really been helping my dry skin this winter. My face feels much more moisturized and looks brighter after one mask! I will definitely be getting more so that I can keep it up during the dry months.

avis.titre: Too early to notice any results
avis.texte: I used this mask, but I wasn't sure what the outcome was supposed to be. It left my skin moisturized and bright, but I'm not entirely sure how that's different from other masks. Maybe more uses will bring about results

I like this mask a lot! It feels very soothing on the skin, and is comfortable to wear. After it dried a little I was able to blow dry my hair with it on! The only thing is I think the packaging could be improved because when I took it out of the package, the bottom part of the top half was wrinkled as it had slid out of the plastic packaging inside the pack. This interferes somewhat with the ability of the mask to stick to your nose, since that's already a difficult area for masks to stick to due to the curvature. Otherwise, I love it and can't wait to use the rest of the masks!

I live in the desert where we don't have a winter and went to visit my daughter in the snow for a few days. I packed in kind of a hurry and didn't bring all of my skincare. I came back and my face was a wreck! I remembered I had these masks and thought I would try one out. The difference was immediate! My skin was soft, glowing, and dewy. COSRX has saved me again! I will be buying more of these to always have on hand. Love them.
Love this mask! My skin felt hydrated and looked so good! Will be using these forever!!

These masks are lightweight yet so moisturizing! It doesn't feel sticky or thick in a bad way. It really nourishes the skin, especially after shaving. It is really great for my sensitive acne prone skin. I love the rubber type mask because it really holds the moisture in and doesn't evaporate like other masks!

avis.titre: Not Big on Face Masks, But…
avis.texte: I don't typically use face masks, but this one was so nice! The mask itself felt good on my skin and it barely moved as I left it on. Once I took it off it left my skin feeling so moisturised and soft! I would definitely get it again :slightly_smiling:‍↕️
